articles.title: Hyderabad Advocate Dies After Suspected Targeted Vehicle Hit Amid Waqf Land Dispute Allegations
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Tension gripped parts of Hyderabad after advocate Khaja Mohiuddin of Masab Tank died following a suspected targeted vehicle attack, with police probing possible links to an ongoing Waqf land dispute in Malakpet.

body.html:
Tension gripped parts of Hyderabad after advocate Khaja Mohiuddin of Masab Tank died following a suspected targeted vehicle attack, with police probing possible links to an ongoing Waqf land dispute in Malakpet.

According to sources, investigators have collected CCTV footage connected to the incident and formed special teams to trace and arrest the suspects, who are currently absconding.

Following the advocate’s death, his son Farhan made serious allegations while speaking to the media.

Farhan claimed that this was the sixth attack on his father and alleged that Khaja Mohiuddin had been fighting legal battles for several years to protect Waqf Board properties from alleged encroachments.

He accused Nawab Mujahed Alam Khan and Nawab Mahboob Alam Khan of illegally occupying Waqf land and constructing educational institutions on the disputed properties. According to Farhan, his father had filed multiple court cases challenging the alleged encroachments despite receiving repeated threats.

Farhan further alleged that one of the accused had visited their office nearly six months ago and directly threatened him. He also claimed that the family’s office premises had been attacked several times in the past.

Expressing fear for the family’s safety, Farhan said that if anything happens to him or any family member, the individuals named by him should be held responsible.

He appealed to the Telangana government and Hyderabad Police to provide immediate security protection to the family following the incident.

Hyderabad Police have registered a case and launched a detailed investigation. Authorities said all possible angles, including the alleged Waqf land dispute connection, are being examined.

Further investigation is underway.

#Hyderabad #Telangana #WaqfLand #CrimeNews #BreakingNews

articles.title: CCTV Captures Stray Dog Attack in Bengaluru’s Ramamurthy Nagar
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A female student was injured after allegedly being attacked by a pack of stray dogs in Bengaluru’s Hoysala Nagar area near Ramamurthy Nagar, raising fresh concerns over the growing stray dog menace in the city.

body.html:
A female student was injured after allegedly being attacked by a pack of stray dogs in Bengaluru’s Hoysala Nagar area near Ramamurthy Nagar, raising fresh concerns over the growing stray dog menace in the city.

The incident reportedly took place on Thursday evening and was captured on CCTV cameras installed in the locality.

The student, identified as Meghana, was allegedly walking through the area when a group of more than 10 to 15 stray dogs began barking and suddenly chased her.

According to eyewitnesses, one of the dogs bit the student multiple times while the rest of the pack surrounded and lunged at her, triggering panic in the area.

The CCTV footage shows the terrified student trying to escape as the dogs aggressively chase and attack her on the road.

Residents said the dogs were blocking the pathway when Meghana approached, after which the animals allegedly turned aggressive.

The student reportedly screamed for help and managed to move away before suffering more serious injuries.

She was immediately rushed to the KR Puram Government Hospital, where doctors provided primary treatment for the bite wounds. Officials said she sustained minor injuries and is currently out of danger.

The incident has once again highlighted concerns regarding stray dog attacks in Bengaluru. Residents of the locality alleged that repeated complaints to civic authorities about the growing number of stray dogs have not resulted in effective action.

The latest incident comes just days after another woman reportedly suffered serious injuries in a separate stray dog attack in Bengaluru’s HSR Layout area.

Residents have now urged the Bruhat Bengaluru Mahanagara Palike (BBMP) to take urgent steps to control the stray dog population and improve public safety.

Authorities have not yet issued an official statement regarding the incident.

#Bengaluru #RamamurthyNagar #StrayDogs #DogAttack

articles.title: Family Alleges Conversion Pressure After Meerut Staff Nurse Found Dead Outside Medical College
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A shocking murder case involving a 25-year-old staff nurse in Uttar Pradesh’s Meerut has taken a dramatic turn after the victim’s family alleged that she was being pressured to convert and marry the main accused.

body.html:
A shocking murder case involving a 25-year-old staff nurse in Uttar Pradesh’s Meerut has taken a dramatic turn after the victim’s family alleged that she was being pressured to convert and marry the main accused.

The victim, identified as Anjali Sharma, worked as a staff nurse at Lala Lajpat Rai Medical College and was living in Jagriti Vihar Sector 3.

According to police, Anjali was allegedly murdered on May 21 by ward boy Sufian and his sister Sajida. After the murder, Sajida allegedly loaded the body onto an e-rickshaw, transported it to the medical college, dumped it outside the emergency gate, and fled the spot.

Police scanned CCTV footage from the hospital premises and identified Sajida sitting in the e-rickshaw wearing a helmet. She was arrested the same day along with her mother. During interrogation, Sajida allegedly confessed to involvement in the murder. However, the main accused, Sufian, is still absconding.

Anjali had married Sunny, a resident of Sector 8, in 2018 and had a five-year-old son. Family members said she had been living separately from her husband for the past year due to marital disputes, and a divorce case was pending in court.

According to relatives, Anjali met Sufian while working at the medical college, and the two later became friends. Her family alleged that Sufian had been pressuring her to convert to Islam and marry him, but she repeatedly refused.

Anjali’s sister Neha claimed she saw messages on the victim’s phone allegedly sent by Sufian asking her to leave her husband and child, convert, and marry him.

The accused Sajida allegedly told police that Anjali had visited Lohia Nagar on May 21, where an argument broke out over marriage. She claimed the fight escalated, after which Anjali was allegedly strangled to death before the body was dumped outside the medical college.

Anjali’s brother Pradeep alleged that the accused had been harassing his sister for a long time and accused them of kidnapping and murdering her as part of a planned conspiracy.

Family members also claimed there were injury marks on Anjali’s neck, hands and legs, suggesting assault before death.

Police said the investigation is ongoing. Meerut SP City Vinayak Gopal Bhosale stated that, so far, the investigation has not confirmed allegations related to forced religious conversion. However, police have recovered WhatsApp chats and are examining them as part of the probe.

Further investigation is underway.

#Meerut #UttarPradesh #CrimeNews #NurseMurder #BreakingNews

articles.title: Varanasi Student Alleges Assault by Classmates After Exam
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A social media influencer and student of Mahatma Gandhi Kashi Vidyapith in Varanasi was allegedly assaulted by two girls on the university campus following an argument after examinations.

body.html:
A social media influencer and student of Mahatma Gandhi Kashi Vidyapith in Varanasi was allegedly assaulted by two girls on the university campus following an argument after examinations.

The incident reportedly took place around 4:30 pm on Friday after fourth-semester exams concluded at the Faculty of Humanities.

The victim, identified as Vaishnavi, is a Mass Communication student and Instagram influencer with thousands of followers across two social media accounts. According to students, farewell celebrations were taking place on campus after the exams, with classmates writing messages on each other’s T-shirts and taking photos.

Vaishnavi alleged that while leaving the campus after her exam, a girl commented about her. In response, she allegedly told the girl to “shut up, fatty,” following which the situation escalated.

According to Vaishnavi, the girl, along with two others identified as Prachi Pandey and Aishwarya Pandey, allegedly chased her inside the campus, pulled her hair, threw her to the ground, and assaulted her.

Videos circulating on social media reportedly show two girls surrounding and beating Vaishnavi while several students gathered at the spot. Some female students attempted to intervene and stop the fight.

Vaishnavi alleged that despite the chaos, security guards present on campus did not intervene and remained silent spectators.

In an emotional video recorded after the incident, Vaishnavi claimed the assault was part of a conspiracy to defame her. She also alleged that the accused attempted to tear her clothes during the attack.

Students of the university said there had reportedly been an ongoing dispute between Vaishnavi and the other girls, which escalated into a physical altercation after both sides exchanged abuses on Friday.

Vaishnavi also claimed that the name of a young man has surfaced in connection with the dispute, though his identity has not yet been confirmed.

The influencer reportedly runs two Instagram accounts — “queen_of_hell18” with around 82,000 followers and “vaishnavii_official” with nearly 90,000 followers — where she posts content related to beauty products, lifestyle, and daily essentials.

Inspector Shivkant Mishra of Sigra police station said police are aware of the incident, but no formal complaint has been filed by either side so far.

“The matter is in cognisance. Information regarding the incident is being collected after speaking to the Chief Proctor,” the officer said.

#Varanasi #ViralVideo #UttarPradesh #StudentClash #BreakingNews

articles.title: Sangli Village Officer Killed After Car Rams Parked Truck on Highway
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A senior government official lost his life in a horrific road accident after his speeding car reportedly lost control and crashed into a stationary container truck on the Ratnagiri-Nagpur National Highway near Miraj in Maharashtra.

body.html:
A senior government official lost his life in a horrific road accident after his speeding car reportedly lost control and crashed into a stationary container truck on the Ratnagiri-Nagpur National Highway near Miraj in Maharashtra.

The deceased was identified as Mahesh Manohar Bhamane, a Gramsevak (village servant) from Kosari in Sangli district’s Jat area.

According to preliminary information, Mahesh Bhamane was travelling from Jat towards Miraj when the accident occurred near Kalambi village on the highway.

CCTV footage of the incident, which has now gone viral on social media, reportedly shows the car suddenly moving across lanes at high speed before crashing into a parked container truck on the roadside.

Police said the impact of the collision was extremely severe, completely crushing the front portion of the vehicle. Mahesh Bhamane sustained critical injuries and died on the spot.

The accident reportedly took place after the car crossed multiple lanes of the highway before slamming into the stationary container.

Soon after receiving information, Miraj Rural Police and emergency teams rushed to the spot. The body was later taken for post-mortem examination.

Authorities have launched an investigation to determine the exact cause of the accident and whether overspeeding or negligence led to the fatal crash.

Further investigation is underway.

#Maharashtra #Sangli #Miraj #CCTV #BreakingNews

articles.title: “Beer Bath in Ganga?”: Viral Video from Varanasi Triggers FIR
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A viral video showing a youth allegedly consuming beer while bathing in the Ganga river in Varanasi has sparked outrage, following which police registered an FIR against an unidentified person on Friday.

body.html:
A viral video showing a youth allegedly consuming beer while bathing in the Ganga river in Varanasi has sparked outrage, following which police registered an FIR against an unidentified person on Friday.

The case was lodged by Dashashwamedh police based on a complaint filed by advocate Shashank Tripathi.

Police registered the FIR under Sections 196 of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS) for promoting enmity and disturbing communal harmony, and Section 299 for deliberate and malicious acts intended to outrage religious feelings.

According to eyewitnesses, the incident took place around 5 am when the youth arrived at the ghat with his friends for bathing in the Ganga. While inside the river, he was allegedly seen holding a beer can and drinking from it.

People present at the spot reportedly objected and accused him of disrespecting the river. In the viral video, a man can be heard confronting the youth in Hindi, saying, “Brahmin hoke beer pee rahe ho, tumko samajh nahi aata Ganga nadi mein?” (You are a Brahmin and still drinking beer? Don’t you understand this is the Ganga river?)

The accused is then heard replying, “Ab nahi piyenge” (I won’t drink now).

The clip quickly spread across social media platforms, with many users calling it an insult to religious sentiments and demanding strict action.

ACP Dashashwamedh Atul Anjan Tripathi said police teams have been formed to identify and arrest the accused seen in the video.

The incident comes nearly two months after 14 youths were jailed for allegedly organising an iftar party on a boat in the Ganga in Varanasi and dumping non-vegetarian biryani waste into the river. Those accused were later granted bail by the Allahabad High Court.

Further investigation is underway.

#Varanasi #Ganga #ViralVideo #UttarPradesh #BreakingNews

articles.title: “Old Torture Video Surfaces After Woman Found Dead”: Husband Detained in Suspicious Death Case
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A disturbing case from Telangana’s Khammam district has triggered outrage after a 28-year-old woman was found dead at her home and an old video allegedly showing her husband brutally assaulting her surfaced online.

body.html:
A disturbing case from Telangana’s Khammam district has triggered outrage after a 28-year-old woman was found dead at her home and an old video allegedly showing her husband brutally assaulting her surfaced online.

The victim, identified as R Meenakshi, was found **** inside the bedroom of her house in Gol Thanda village under Thirumalayapalem mandal on Friday morning.

Police initially treated the case as a suspected ****. However, Meenakshi’s family strongly rejected the claim and accused her husband, R Shivaji, of murdering her.

The couple had reportedly been married for nearly 14 years and were living in the village with their child.

According to Meenakshi’s parents and relatives, Shivaji had allegedly been harassing and physically assaulting her for several years. Family members claimed he wanted control over property registered in her name as well as a life insurance policy reportedly worth around ₹1 crore.

Following her death, relatives gathered at the Thirumalayapalem police station demanding that police register a murder case against Shivaji instead of treating the matter as ****.

The controversy intensified after an old video surfaced online on Friday. The disturbing footage allegedly shows Shivaji beating Meenakshi with a belt while she appears to be tied up. In the clip, Meenakshi can reportedly be heard crying in pain and pleading, while their child is also heard crying nearby.

Police said the video was old and had allegedly been recorded earlier by one of Meenakshi’s relatives. However, it was not made public at the time after family members from both sides reportedly intervened and reached a compromise.

According to police, Shivaji had allegedly assured the family that he would stop assaulting her. However, Meenakshi’s family alleged that the abuse and harassment continued even after that.

Thirumalayapalem Police Station Inspector V Srinivas said police are awaiting the post-mortem report to determine the exact cause of death.

“He definitely beat her up. We have brought him to the police station for questioning. We will modify the FIR once the post-mortem reveals whether it is **** or murder,” the officer said.

Police clarified that although earlier reports claimed Shivaji was absconding, he has now been detained for questioning.

Further investigation is underway.

#Telangana #Khammam #DomesticViolence #CrimeNews #BreakingNews

articles.title: Man Dragged 500 Metres on Moving Car After Money Dispute in Mysuru
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A shocking incident was reported from Karnataka’s Mysuru where a man was allegedly dragged for nearly 500 metres on the bonnet of a moving car following a dispute over repayment of money.

body.html:
A shocking incident was reported from Karnataka’s Mysuru where a man was allegedly dragged for nearly 500 metres on the bonnet of a moving car following a dispute over repayment of money.

The dramatic incident, which was caught on camera, took place on the busy stretch from Kuvempunagar Police Station road to the Sub-Registrar’s Office near Andolana Circle.

Videos circulating on social media show a man clinging to the bonnet of a red Maruti Suzuki Baleno while the vehicle speeds through the crowded road.

According to preliminary reports, the dispute involved two men identified as Mahadev and Dhananjay. Police said Mahadev had allegedly lent money to Dhananjay and approached him seeking repayment.

An argument reportedly broke out between the two, following which Dhananjay allegedly attempted to leave the spot in his car.

In an attempt to stop him, Mahadev allegedly jumped onto the bonnet of the vehicle and held on to it. However, instead of stopping, the driver allegedly continued driving at high speed with Mahadev hanging dangerously from the front of the car.

The incident created panic among motorists and pedestrians in the area, while videos and photographs of the stunt-like scene quickly went viral online.

Taking note of the footage, local police registered a case and launched an investigation into the incident.

Police officials confirmed that both parties are being questioned and CCTV footage along with viral videos is being examined as part of the probe.

Initial findings suggest the altercation was directly linked to a financial dispute between the two men. Authorities said further legal action will be taken based on the outcome of the investigation.

#Mysuru #Karnataka #ViralVideo #CrimeNews #BreakingNews

articles.title: “Speeding EV Turns Into Missile”: Electric Car Crashes Into Tiffin Centre in Hyderabad’s Kukatpally
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Panic gripped Hyderabad’s Kukatpally area after a speeding electric car went out of control and crashed into multiple vehicles before ramming into a roadside tiffin centre on Wednesday, May 20.

body.html:
Panic gripped Hyderabad’s Kukatpally area after a speeding electric car went out of control and crashed into multiple vehicles before ramming into a roadside tiffin centre on Wednesday, May 20.

The incident took place near Vivekananda Nagar Arch while the car was travelling towards Allwyn Colony.

According to eyewitnesses, the electric car was moving at a very high speed when the driver allegedly lost control. The vehicle first rammed into a two-wheeler, then hit an auto-rickshaw and another car before crashing into the tiffin centre.

A video of the incident shared on social media shows the car speeding through the road, hitting vehicles and making a sharp turn moments before smashing into the eatery.

The sudden crash created panic in the busy locality, with customers inside the tiffin centre, shopkeepers, motorists and pedestrians running for safety after hearing the loud impact.

Police said several vehicles and property at the tiffin centre were damaged in the accident. A few people reportedly suffered minor injuries, but no deaths or serious injuries were reported.

According to Kukatpally Police, the incident occurred around 10:30 am. A case of rash and negligent driving has been registered under Section 106(1) of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS).

Police teams reached the spot soon after receiving information and launched an investigation. Authorities are currently examining CCTV footage from the area to identify and trace the accused driver.

The damaged vehicles were later removed to clear traffic congestion on the busy road.

Further investigation is underway.

#Hyderabad #Kukatpally #RoadAccident #ElectricCar #ViralVideo

articles.title: “Thar vs Thar on City Road”: Violent Clash Over Woman Triggers Chaos in Vijayawada
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A dramatic clash involving two Thar jeeps on the busy Patamata High Tension 100 Feet Road in Vijayawada triggered panic among motorists and locals in the early hours of Friday, May 22.

body.html:
A dramatic clash involving two Thar jeeps on the busy Patamata High Tension 100 Feet Road in Vijayawada triggered panic among motorists and locals in the early hours of Friday, May 22.

According to preliminary information, the confrontation took place between two youths identified as Rohit and Om, allegedly over a young woman.

The dispute reportedly escalated into a violent road chase, with both sides ramming their Thar jeeps into each other in the middle of the road, creating scenes resembling an action movie sequence.

Eyewitnesses said the youths also attacked the vehicles using iron rods, smashing windows and damaging the SUVs during the clash.

The incident caused heavy commotion in the area, forcing motorists and pedestrians to run for safety as the violence unfolded on the busy stretch.

Police said a young woman present inside one of the vehicles has also been identified as part of the ongoing investigation.

After receiving information about the clash, police rushed to the spot and brought the situation under control. However, one of the accused, identified as Lingamaneni Rohit, allegedly fled before officers arrived.

Police later detained Bolla Om during the night and questioned him regarding the incident.

Authorities are now examining CCTV footage and recording statements from eyewitnesses to establish the exact sequence of events and confirm the motive behind the violent clash.

Further investigation is underway.

#AndhraPradesh #Thar #RoadRage #ViralVideo #BreakingNews
